population.source_description: Historical critically ill hospital patients at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Centre,Boston;derived from MIMIC-II matched waveforms.

permissions.statement: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By-1.0); preserve the accompanying legacy PhysioNet modified-data notice and attribution. Verbatim original only.
permissions.attribution: Contains information from the BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset v1.0.0,Marco Pimentel,Alistair Johnson,Peter Charlton and David Clifton,PhysioNet,DOI:10.13026/C2208R,made available under the ODC Attribution License v1.0.Cite Pimentel et al.,Towards a Robust Estimation of Respiratory Rate from Pulse Oximeters,DOI:10.1109/TBME.2016.2613124,and the PhysioNet resource citation listed in the source README.
restrictions: Retain the ODC-By license URI,attribution and all accompanying source notices with redistributed bytes/documentation;no sublicense or additional restriction on granted database rights.
Original CSV is unmodified and retained verbatim.The source's existing MIMIC-II extraction/Matlab/CSV modification notice is retained separately,unchanged.
Future modified data must be distinctly named and identified with source/changes under the legacy policy;this task produces no modified signal dataset.
Database licensing does not waive privacy,personality,trademark or other content rights.No re-identification,patient linkage or implied clinical/PhysioNet endorsement.

suitability: Bounded scalar schema,ordering,missingness and future replay-pipeline tests only;not astronaut baselines,clinical thresholds,diagnosis or model validation.
transformations: Original bytes unmodified.Offline validation reads CSV and represents literal NaN as null in derived summaries;no imputation,resampling or rewritten signal file.
scientific_limitations: Public historical ICU-derived numerics,not private/live patient data or astronaut measurements.No direct identifying fields appear in this selected CSV;independent anonymization certification is not claimed.
Only one complete 1Hz numerics file;no ECG/PPG/respiration waveform,breath annotation,demographics or second recording acquired.
Hospital selection bias,treatment/sensor effects and terrestrial-to-spaceflight domain shift prohibit astronaut threshold calibration or disease inference.
NaN stays missing;no interpolation,imputation or independent clinical-quality score is generated.
Publisher SHA256SUMS review exceeded the15s deadline;not retried.Hash is computed from complete official HTTPS review bytes,not independently matched to publisher checksum.
Monitor numerics are not independently adjudicated ground truth.Heart and pulse rates are distinct channels.
No absolute acquisition date is available in this CSV;repository retrieval time is not observation time.
One eight-minute record provides neither subject-independent holdouts nor broad hospital/spaceflight generalization.
